## Case studies

- [Working at Botpress](https://carsonspriggs.com/case-studies/botpress): built
  the Jira integration and Topic Insights conversation analytics in Botpress
  Desk, and moved AI jobs onto a queue.
- [Accessibility at Fundica](https://carsonspriggs.com/case-studies/fundica):
  led a WCAG audit, shipped the fixes with the team, and built an auditing tool
  that cut time per page by up to 99% versus manual auditing.
- [Argus](https://carsonspriggs.com/case-studies/argus): a video surveillance
  platform built with Marcus Lee in 37 hours at Cal Hacks 12.0 (San Francisco);
  Mux streaming, Gemini and Roboflow event detection, searchable events. Two
  first-place finishes.
- [CropCare](https://carsonspriggs.com/case-studies/cropcare): John Abbott
  College capstone — a Raspberry Pi container farm with Azure IoT Hub and a
  .NET MAUI app, by a team of three.
- [Linky](https://carsonspriggs.com/case-studies/linky): a chatbot that answers
  only from the links it is given, built overnight with Marcus Lee at MariHacks
  2024 — first hackathon win.
- [TradeMind](https://carsonspriggs.com/case-studies/trademind): a
  machine-learning model for stock data, built in a Jupyter notebook during AI
  Launch Lab's Winter 2024 R&D program.
